integrity: All infinite-support and parameter-uniform claims are argued analytically; accompanying code provides independent arithmetic diagnostics only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem disproves the unrestricted variance-only sup-norm conjecture through a full-support family. It does not give a replacement positive bound or settle the first-difference conjecture. Finite diagnostics cannot establish infinite-support assertions. Historical priority is not independently settled; the full Brown--Xia (2001) article was not obtainable.
title: A fixed-mean ultra-log-concave obstruction to variance-only Stein sup-norm bounds
